lines.t: ‎*(Verse 1 – The Enemy's Deception)*
‎In the hidden corners where darkness weaves its web,
‎The adversary whispers lies to the hearts of men,
‎Leading them down paths of greed and endless strife,
‎Building towers of pride that pierce the endless sky.
‎He sows seeds of hatred, divides the kin from kin,
‎Promising power in chains, where true freedom ends.
‎With cunning schemes, he blinds the eyes to light,
‎Turning brothers to foes in the dead of night.
‎[Chorus – spoken hook]
‎Oh, see the plumes ascending, black and white they blend,
‎A sign from heaven's throne that the end draws near, my friend.
‎The wicked tremble as the fires ignite below,
‎For the Judge of all declares what the reapers sow.
‎Righteous is His hand, pure in every decree,
‎Bringing low the haughty, setting captives free.
‎The foe delights in chaos, in the spill of innocent blood,
‎Orchestrating wars that flood the earth like a raging flood.
‎He twists the truth to falsehoods, enslaves the soul in sin,
‎Feeding on despair where hope should have begun.
‎Nations stumble blindly, chasing shadows in the mist,
‎Allied with the deceiver, clenched in his iron fist.
‎Yet in his arrogance, he forgets the higher law,
‎That every evil deed invites the final awe.
‎But hear the voice of mercy, echoing through the storm,
‎The Creator's wrath is holy, in perfect, loving form.
‎He does not strike in vengeance born of fleeting rage,
‎But to cleanse the world from evil's poisoned page.
‎For in His eyes, all secrets lay bare and exposed,
‎The scales of justice tip where righteousness is posed.
‎Though smoke may choke the air and flames devour the land,
‎It's the shield for the faithful, by His mighty hand.
‎Oh, see the plumes ascending, black and white they blend,
‎A sign from heaven's throne that the end draws near, my friend.
‎The wicked tremble as the fires ignite below,
‎For the Judge of all declares what the reapers sow.
‎Righteous is His hand, pure in every decree,
‎Bringing low the haughty, setting captives free.
‎The enemy parades in robes of false delight,
‎But crumbles at the dawn of everlasting light.
‎His empire built on sand will wash away in time,
‎As the righteous rise above his every crime.
‎Turn from the shadowed trail, seek the path of grace,
‎Where forgiveness waits in the Savior's embrace.
‎YahuShua HaMashiach, the King who conquered death,
‎Leads the way to peace with every sacred breath.
‎[Final Chorus – spoken hook]
‎Oh, see the plumes ascending, harbingers of change,
‎The enemy's defeat in the fire's righteous range.
‎No force of darkness stands against the Holy One,
‎His judgment pure, His victory already won.
‎Righteous is His hand, eternal in its might,
‎Dispelling every shadow, bringing endless light.
